content.text: 4. INSTALL RACK END GUIDE AND WAVE WASHER
Install the rack end guide with oil groove facing toward the staked groove.

content.text: 5. INSTALL CYLINDER END STOPPER WITH O-RING

items: (a) Insert SST to the oil seal of the cylinder end stopper.
• Install one SST into the other.
• Install two SST into the oil seal.
• Remove one SST from the other.

content.text: (b) Install the cylinder end stopper to the cylinder housing.
6. INSTALL RACK HOUSING TO CYLINDER HOUSING
NOTE: Make sure that the O-ring, spacer and seal are installed between the rack housing and the cylinder housing.
(b) Install the four bolts and torque them.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of cylinder end stopper nut using SST tool. Shows both close-up detail and full assembly view.

content.text: (a) Coat liquid sealer onto the screw surface of the new nut.
(b) Install the cylinder end stopper nut with SST and torque the nut.
(c) Stake the end stopper nut to the cylinder housing flange.
